fusions.name: Undertow
fusions.desc: Winds every arm around a weakened enemy, hauls it under and rolls with it for 20 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Sprung From Stillness
fusions.desc: Lunges from stillness with every arm, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles ahead and seizing each one, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Settled in the Silt
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Grip Past Struggling
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
